CallContext.description:
What a call carries besides its arguments: where, who, its taint and where it came from.

The approvals and the egress policy read the same context.

correlation_id.description: The id that ties the call to the turn, run or session that made it, in logs and audit.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

scope.description: The tenant's workspace the call is made in.

surface.description: The surface the call came from, such as ``portalr``, ``mcp`` or ``acp``.
surface.title: Surface

taint.description: The caller's taint: its turn's, run's or session's.

via.description:
The outside client the call came through, or None for a call from lattice's own
surfaces.

CallContext.title: CallContext

Capability.description:
A tool an agent can call, as its provider declares it.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the name isn't of :data:`NAME`'s form, the version isn't of
        :data:`VERSION`'s, the description is empty, or a limit isn't a setting's key.

description.description: What it does, for the agent that picks it and the person who approves it.
description.title: Description

effects.description: What a call does that taint reads.
effects.title: Effects

gate.description: The integration and the grantr action that gate it.

input_schema.description: The JSON Schema of its arguments.

limits.description:
The keys of the settings that limit it (lattice ADR-0030), such as
``calls-per-hour:mcp-github``.
limits.title: Limits

name.description: Its provider, a dot and its tool: ``artifactr.edit_text``, ``mcp.github.create_issue``.
name.title: Name

output_schema.description: The JSON Schema of its output, or None if it declares none.

provider.description: The kind of provider that offers it.
provider.title: Provider

reversibility.description: Whether a call can be undone.
reversibility.title: Reversibility

risk_class.description: A risk class beyond its tier, if it has one.
risk_class.title: Risk Class

version.description: The tool's own semantic version: a new input field is a minor version.
version.title: Version

Capability.title: Capability

Cause.description:
What tainted a turn, a run or a session: a capability or an event, and when.

Raises:
    ValueError: Unless exactly one of ``capability`` and ``event`` is given.

capability.description: The name of the capability whose result was read.
capability.title: Capability

event.description: The id of the event whose untrusted content was read, such as a matched envelope's.
event.title: Event

Cause.title: Cause

Gate.description:
What gates a capability: the integration it needs on, and the grantr action it needs.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``integration`` isn't an integration key, or ``action`` isn't of
        :data:`ACTION`'s form.

action.description: The grantr action the caller must hold, such as ``artifactr:edit_artifact``.
action.title: Action

different_approver.description: Whether an approval of a call must come from someone other than the caller.
different_approver.title: Different Approver

integration.description: An integration's key (lattice ADR-0027), or None for a capability always installed.
integration.title: Integration

Gate.title: Gate

PersonCaller.description: A person calling for themselves, by their identity provider's id.
PersonCaller.title: PersonCaller

RunCaller.description: An agent's run, or a stored workflow's, calling as part of its work.

agent.description: The agent or stored workflow the run runs, whose tier ceiling applies.
agent.title: Agent

on_behalf_of.description: The id of the person the run acts for, if it acts for one.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

RunCaller.title: RunCaller

Scope.description: Where capabilities are offered and called: a tenant's workspace.
Scope.title: Scope

SessionCaller.description: A code session calling as part of its work.

on_behalf_of.description: The id of the person the session acts for, if it acts for one.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

SessionCaller.title: SessionCaller

Tainted.description: Untrusted content has been read: by what and when, and the hosts seen since.

causes.description: What tainted it, in the order it was read.
causes.title: Causes

seen_hosts.description: The hosts that appeared in what was read, the only ones a narrowed call may reach.
seen_hosts.title: Seen Hosts

Tainted.title: Tainted

output.description: The call's output, as JSON, of the capability's ``output_schema`` where it declares one.

Via.description:
The outside client a call came through (lattice RFC-0014).

A provider builds its actor from it, the client acting for the caller, so grants are the
caller's own and audit names the client.

client_name.description: The client's name, as audit shows it: "Alex via Claude".
client_name.title: Client Name

connection_id.description: The id of the connection the client called through.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

surface.description: The protocol the client called through.
surface.title: Surface

Via.title: Via

description: lattice's capability contract: `capability` is a tool as its provider declares it, `context` what a call carries besides its arguments, and `result` what it returns.
title: lattice.capabilities 1.0.0
